AP0113 caption: first Newhall School 1879-1890, NE corner Walnut and Ninth.
AP0123: Reynolds says Felton School District created and schoolhouse built 1885.

Mary F. Brunner et al., Newhall History Project (June 1940), History of Newhall Elementary School: 1878 Lyon home; 1879 9th and Walnut; May 1890 fire; 1911 new site NW corner Newhall Ave and Pico Road; building of 1926 and 1928 at 1113 Walnut; 14 Feb 1939 fire; new building occupied 10 May 1940.
Brunner 1940, Newhall Elementary School bus system: 1919 start; 1932 Chevrolet 31-seat bus acquired.
Brunner 1940, Newhall School District organization: formed 10 May 1877 on petition of J.F. Powell and 47 others; earliest teachers.
GR0221 caption: school moved from Lyons Ave to Walnut and Eleventh in 1928; burned 1939.
HB5601 caption: Saugus School District formed 12 Nov 1908 from Newhall SD "(est. 1879)" and Castaic SD (1889). Internal conflict with the 1877 date.
HS0731 caption: second Newhall School 1890-1914; third school 1914-1928 on north side of 10th St (Lyons), west of Newhall Ave.
Castaic School District formed 25 Mar 1889 (citing Reynolds 1992:80).
Los Angeles Herald, 4 June 1890: Newhall school burned "a few days ago".
Leon Worden, Story of Sulphur Springs School (5 Mar 1997): original schoolhouse Santa Clarita's first; second-oldest district in LA County.
LW3347 caption: Substation No. 6 at NE corner of Spruce and 6th (today's Main and 6th); replaced May 1972 by a station in the county Civic Center; later The Signal, then Canyon Theatre Guild.
LW7001 caption: County Civic Center groundbreaking 11 Feb 1970, NW corner Valencia Blvd and Magic Mountain Pkwy; sheriff's station moved there 1972.
LW9801 and The Signal 26 Apr 1998: Sulphur Springs 125th anniversary; "the Santa Clarita Valley's oldest school district, Sulphur Springs, was founded in 1872"; 1886 site and adobe schoolhouse.
SCVHistory Newhall Schools index: lists the pages and photos on the four/five Newhall School buildings; labels Fourth Newhall School 1925 to 2-14-1939; 5-10-1940 to present.

Leon Worden, History of Newhall School (Old Town Newhall Gazette Sept 1997, rev. 2020): district formed 10 May 1877; 1878-79 class in Lyon bunkhouse roughly where Valencia Marketplace stands; 1879 school NE corner 9th and Walnut; 1890 fire; 1911 or 1914 third school on 10th St (Lyons); 1928 Eleventh and Walnut; 1939 fire; reopened 10 May 1940; later schools.

City of Santa Clarita release, 25 July 2018: groundbreaking for new SCV Sheriff's Station on Golden Valley Road; City and County financing; replaces 25,100 sq ft station at 23740 Magic Mountain Parkway that opened in 1972.
SD0100 caption (text from Estelle Foley): Substation No. 6 set up 1926 at Sixth and Spruce; 1972 move to County Civic Center in Valencia.
A.B. Perkins, Story of Our Valley, editor's notes: Felton School District absorbed into Newhall SD 1933.
Jerry Reynolds, History of the SCV, ch. 33: Sulphur Springs School District formed Sept 1872, second-oldest in LA County.
Reynolds ch. 36: Judge Powell contributed to first official Newhall School, 1879, $3,500.
Reynolds ch. 47: Newhall School at Ninth and Walnut; burned 1890; second built with Needham's help.
Reynolds ch. 49: children taught in a bunk house on Lyon property in 1878; Lyon land below Pico Canyon west of I-5.
Reynolds ch. 71: Newhall schools burned 1890 and 1914; third near NW corner Newhall Ave and Lyons; 1928 move to Eleventh and Walnut; 1939 fire.
Leon Worden, The Signal, 8 Nov 1996: Substation No. 6 opened 26 Aug 1926 at 6th and Spruce (San Fernando Road); moved to the Civic Center in 1972.
Leon Worden, The Signal, 17 Sept 1997: Captain Michael I. Quinn; station at Magic Mountain Pkwy and Valencia Blvd.

Leon Worden, SCV Chronology: Elizabeth Lake SD 12 Aug 1871; Sulphur Springs SD 16 Sept 1872; Newhall SD 10 May 1877; Mint Canyon SD 12 Feb 1879; Felton SD Oct 1885; Castaic SD 25 Mar 1889; Saugus SD 12 Nov 1908; Felton disbanded 1932.
Los Angeles Times, 15 Feb 1939, and AP: Newhall grammar school destroyed by fire early 14 Feb 1939.
Newhall Signal, 17 Feb 1939: school building erected in 1925, wings added 1930; architect Arthur W. Angel.
Newhall Signal, Aug 1925 to Feb 1926: old school property sold to A.B. Perkins for $4,910; building split into three.
Newhall Signal, Aug 1925 to Aug 1926: new school house on Walnut Street ready; school year opens 14 Sept 1925 in the new building.
Felton School memories; webmaster: Felton SD founded 1885, dissolved after 1932 school year.
War memorial page, Rudy Alexander Acosta (d. 2011): high school Santa Clarita Christian School.
